changes: Port the Codex harness to OpenCode: project subagents in .opencode/agents, a version-check plugin in .opencode/plugins, and opencode.json. Repository skills, episodes, tools and the deterministic engine are unchanged from v0.1.1.
Run the orchestrator on openai/gpt-6-astra and the analyst and reviewer on openai/gpt-5.6-terra, all at medium reasoning effort, matching the Codex v0.1.1 roles.

Fix permissions in opencode.json so a production run never waits for a person: no ask rules, the question tool denied, a short list of destructive shell commands denied, no nested agent launches from the analyst or reviewer, and no web access for the reviewer.
known_limits: gates.hull needs a Materials Project API key; without it the gate stays not_run (unchecked).
The ordered-sibling search needs a user-built local ICSD index (assets/icsd_query); no ICSD data ships.
hull.tol_eV_per_atom has no default, so gates.hull reports E_above_hull with pass: null until a threshold is configured.
The frozen-state check requires a git clone with the release tag; a source zip without .git cannot run the judgment layer.
OpenCode has no OS-level sandbox; shell commands are limited only by permission patterns, unlike Codex workspace-write.
There is no LLM approval reviewer in this harness (Codex guardian, Claude Code auto-mode classifier).
The plugin cannot inject a failed session-start check into the model context; it logs it, and blocks campaign-agent launches while the frozen check fails.
The SLURM templates in assets/slurm still call codex exec.

changes: Port the Claude Code harness to Codex project agents, hooks, repository skills, and provenance paths while preserving the domain templates and deterministic engine behavior.
Run the analyst and reviewer with gpt-5.6-terra at medium reasoning effort, and gate every supported agent tool name through one regression-tested version check.
Preserve reviewer scratch reproduction with workspace-write access while disabling hosted web search and nested agent spawning.

The ordered-sibling search needs a user-built local ICSD index (assets/icsd_query); no ICSD data ships.
hull.tol_eV_per_atom has no default, so gates.hull reports E_above_hull with pass: null until a threshold is configured.
The frozen-state check requires a git clone with the release tag; a source zip without .git cannot run the judgment layer.

Codex custom agents do not expose Claude Code's generic per-agent built-in tool allowlist; reviewer safety instead uses workspace-write sandboxing, disabled hosted web search, disabled nested agents, and scoped instructions.

Codex has no equivalent forced skill preload or user-invocable: false setting for these repository skills; correct loading and isolation rely on custom-agent developer instructions and fresh one-entry orchestration.
Parent runtime permission overrides can supersede a custom agent's sandbox default; production runs must not use an unrestricted override such as --yolo.
